name: EnvironmentPackages
description:
EnvironmentPackages lists packages by the manager that installs them.

 Each entry is a registry package name with its manager's own version pin
 (hyperfine@1.18.0, rails:7.1.0, goimports' module@latest, express@4.18.0,
 sqlalchemy==2.0.30, or poppler-utils=22.02.0-2), never a URL, a git
 source or a path. Managers run in the order apt, cargo, gem, go, npm,
 pip; a manager the sandbox's image lacks fails the install, naming what
 to add.

fields.name: Apt
fields.description: Debian packages, as name or name=version.

fields.name: Cargo
fields.description: Rust crates installed with cargo install, as name or name@version.

fields.name: Gem
fields.description: Ruby gems, as name or name:version.

fields.name: Go
fields.description:
Go programs installed with go install, as module/path@version
 (@latest included).

fields.name: Npm
fields.description:
npm packages installed globally, as name, @scope/name, or either with
 @version or @range.

fields.name: Pip
fields.description:
Python packages, as name, name[extras], or either with version
 specifiers such as ==2.0.30 or >=2,<3.
